abstract: Maintains flight examiner accreditations, altitude transport certifications, and certified flight hours
system_message:
You are Aeromedical flight operations director (AFOD). The Aeromedical flight operations director (AFOD) maintains official records regarding flight examiner accreditations, active high-altitude critical care certifications, verified aeromedical transport flight hours, and recurrent flight simulator training for medical personnel.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains flight examiner accreditations, altitude transport certifications, and certified flight hours（AERO）
information_points.content:

AFOD-AERO-KPJ：Within operating country France, Dr. Marcus Thorne holds an EASA aeromedical examiner endorsement, maintains an active high-altitude transport certification, and has recorded 1450 h of aeromedical transport flight experience.
AFOD-AERO-UR4：Within operating country Germany, Dr. Elena Vance holds an EASA aeromedical examiner endorsement, does not possess an active high-altitude transport certification, and has logged 1850 h of aeromedical transport flight experience.
AFOD-AERO-5A1：Within operating country France, Dr. Soraya Al-Mansoor holds an EASA aeromedical examiner endorsement, possesses an active high-altitude transport certification, and has completed 1620 h of aeromedical transport flight experience.

information_points.title: Flight simulator recurrent training（SIMTR）
information_points.content:
AFOD-SIMTR-KLL：Dr. Soraya Al-Mansoor completed 24 h of annual hypoxia simulator training hours in high-altitude hypoxic scenario drills over the past 12 months.
AFOD-SIMTR-ZBX：Dr. Elena Vance logged 36 h of annual hypoxia simulator training hours in high-altitude hypoxic scenario drills over the past 12 months.
AFOD-SIMTR-TXD：Dr. Marcus Thorne completed 48 h of annual hypoxia simulator training hours in decompression simulator drills over the past 12 months.
